what: Family 2: the S8 O-H strategy rebased on what the 2026-09-24 batch measured. Same mesher, same topology, same uniform refinement ratio 1.3 -- only the BASELINE moves.

changes.evidence: chord-only refinement removed 109-127 % of the pressure-drag error that FULL refinement removed, on 3 geometries x 2 incidences, using fewer cells

changes.change: edges=True: LE and TE spacing requests scale with the chordwise count
changes.evidence: gci_C_chord2 raises n_side 45->75 with LE spacing pinned by the 10-degree turning target, degrading nose cell aspect ratio 25.1 -> 32.1. gci_C_edge measured edge spacing alone worth ~7 % of the coarse-to-fine offset.
changes.effect: worst LE turn per cell at the fine level 3.15 deg (gci_FF) -> 2.14 deg (gci2_F)

changes.evidence: measured +0.633 / +0.676 counts on CD at alpha 0 / 4, same sign both incidences, so systematic. No grid refinement removes a domain bias.

deliberately_unchanged.n_span: CL converged to 0.3 % across the chordwise family
deliberately_unchanged.n_normal: CDv converged to 0.5 counts; refining layers alone moved CD +8.2 counts the wrong way
deliberately_unchanged.s0_frac: y+ p99 already 0.77; smaller s0 alone recovered 1 %
deliberately_unchanged.note: baseline is anisotropic ON PURPOSE; the refinement on top of it is uniform, so Richardson extrapolation over family 2 remains legal

verification.compare_meshes_37_metrics: gci_F vs gci2_C: chord_extent, span_extent, interface gap, inverted_cells and cap_out shape all identical; worst_le_turn 4.722 vs 4.739 deg (0.35 %), confirming gci2_C matches gci_F's chordwise AND leading-edge resolution at 46 % of the cells
verification.near_wall_growth_checked: compare_meshes flagged normal_growth_MAX 1.163 -> 1.281, which is the far field where cells are kilometres wide. Measured NEAR-WALL growth over the first 20 layers: gci_C 1.2528 vs gci2_C 1.2615, gci_F 1.1424 vs gci2_F 1.1471. Boundary-layer cell counts inside the flat-plate delta at x/c 0.5: 29 vs 28, 48 vs 47, 62 vs 61. Not degraded.
verification.chord3_rank_probe: gci_C_chord3 (1,367,416 cells) at 4 MPI ranks peaked at 13.0 GiB and was aborted by the guard at 0.7 GiB available. Dropping ranks does NOT fit it on this host; the memory law was accurate. chord3 is cloud-only, and the mesh is built and clean on disk.

key_comparison.claim: gci2_F beats family 1's FINEST level on the two things measured to matter
key_comparison.result: 1.29x the chordwise points and 1.47x finer LE turning, for 14 % FEWER cells

measured_2026_09_24_evening.runs: gci2_C on g83 and g47 at alpha 0 and 4, all converged and gate-ACCEPTED
measured_2026_09_24_evening.controlled_comparison: gci2_C and gci_C_chord2 carry the SAME chordwise count (xi 157), so the difference is exactly edge-spacing scaling plus far field 40->60 chords.
measured_2026_09_24_evening.reading: CDp moves DOWN on all four cases, the same direction refinement moves it, so the edge scaling is doing what it was added to do. CDv moves UP, and by more than the far field explains (+0.361 of it). Net CD therefore changes SIGN between geometries: +1.4 on g83, -0.7 on g47. Family 2 is a clear improvement on pressure drag and is NOT unambiguously better on total drag at the coarse level.

correction_to_this_documents_own_justifi.what_was_claimed: n_span and n_normal were held at the baseline on the grounds that 'CDv is converged to 0.5 counts across the chordwise family'.
correction_to_this_documents_own_justifi.why_that_was_incomplete: That measurement was taken on the chordwise family, where the leading-edge spacing is PINNED by the 10-degree turning target and does not refine -- delivered min surface spacing is 0.0914 mm at both 58 and 75 chordwise points. CDv has two competing discretisation errors and that test suppressed one of them.
correction_to_this_documents_own_justifi.interpretation: Finer surface spacing resolves the skin-friction peak and pushes CDv UP; finer s0 and more layers improve the wall gradient and pull CDv DOWN. In the chordwise family the first was frozen, so CDv looked settled when it was only partially exercised.
correction_to_this_documents_own_justifi.does_it_break_family_2: No. refined_level scales s0 and n_normal uniformly from gci2_C, so gci2_M/F/FF exercise both errors and the family remains a legal uniform-refinement ladder. What is weakened is the ARGUMENT for putting the baseline where it is, not the ladder built on top of it. gci2_C's CDv should not be treated as near-converged.
correction_to_this_documents_own_justifi.geometry_dependence: The CDv jump is 1.850 on g83 and 0.455 on g47 at alpha 0 -- a factor of four. Sensitivity of viscous drag to surface spacing is geometry-dependent, which two geometries cannot characterise.
